vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sets out to find A woman, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
🚶 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is back — found A woman, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A woman, maybe 40s, with calloused knuckles. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chanpen just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
